title: Android September 2026 Feature Drop: Gemini Item Memory
abstract: Google's September 2026 Android Feature Drop adds Gemini-powered Item Memory to Find Hub, enabling phones to remember item locations without tracker tags. Also includes Gemini integration for security settings on-device.
edge_agent_evidence: Gemini Item Memory在端侧运行无需tracker标签；Google Assistant已被Gemini取代(Sep 4)
recommendation_reason: Google Gemini在端侧Agent能力的重要落地，Item Memory为典型端侧agent用例
title_zh: Android 9月特性更新：Gemini物品记忆功能

title: Google Assistant Shutdown: Gemini Takes Over Mobile Devices
abstract: Google officially retired Google Assistant on September 4, 2026, replacing it with Gemini as the default on-device AI assistant on mobile and Wear OS devices. The same 'Hey Google' hotword now invokes Gemini.
edge_agent_evidence: Gemini完全取代Google Assistant成为端侧默认AI助手，在mobile和Wear OS运行
recommendation_reason: 端侧AI Agent里程碑事件——Gemini全面接管移动端AI交互

title: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 2 Robotics Computer
abstract: NVIDIA announced the Jetson Orin Nano 2 robotics computer for entry-level edge AI, alongside NIM Agent Blueprints. The companion blog details deploying frontier reasoning models (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, Qwen3.8-27B) on Jetson AGX Thor/Orin with NVFP4 quantization achieving 6.28x decode throughput speedup.
edge_agent_evidence: Jetson为边缘计算主力平台；NIM Agent Blueprints支持端侧agent部署；NVFP4量化+投机解码大幅提速
recommendation_reason: NVIDIA Jetson端侧推理平台重要更新，NIM Agent Blueprint直接对应端侧Agent部署
title_zh: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 2 发布及前沿推理模型端侧部署

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE with One UI 9 and Galaxy AI
abstract: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy S26 FE, the first S26 lineup device launching with One UI 9, featuring advanced camera capabilities and Galaxy AI from day one. One UI 9 integrates Gemini Intelligence as the headline Galaxy AI feature.
edge_agent_evidence: Galaxy AI含端侧推理能力；One UI 9集成Gemini Intelligence
recommendation_reason: Samsung One UI 9 + Galaxy AI在端侧AI领域的重要产品落地
title_zh: 三星Galaxy S26 FE发布：One UI 9 + Galaxy AI首日支持

title: Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Price Update and 99% API Cost Reduction
abstract: Xiaomi issued official MiMo V2.5 pricing update (Sep 5) and aggressively slashed API costs by up to 99% as part of China's AI price war. MiMo V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed (1T parameter model) achieves 1000 TPS throughput.
edge_agent_evidence: MiMo系列主要为云端模型，但MiMo-V2-Flash含端侧优化版本
recommendation_reason: 小米MiMo生态动态，以云端为主，端侧关联有限
title_zh: 小米MiMo V2.5定价更新及API成本99%降幅

title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash API Public Beta Launch
abstract: DeepSeek launched the V4-Flash API in public beta with peak/off-peak pricing policy. V4 Pro also available via OpenRouter. DeepSeek V5 rumored for September release but unconfirmed.
recommendation_reason: DeepSeek V4系列为云端模型，与端侧agent直接关联有限

title: Mistral AI Raises €3 Billion
abstract: Mistral AI announced raising €3 billion in new funding on September 8, 2026. The company continues to develop its Ministral model family (3B, 8B, 14B) purpose-built for on-device and edge deployment.

title: Qwen3.8-Max-0902: Same Price, Much Better at Coding
abstract: Qwen3.8-Max-0902 release with improved coding capabilities at the same price point, featuring innovative model architecture.

title: MiniCPM5-2B: SOTA On-Device LLM with Agent Support
abstract: MiniCPM5-2B is a 2B parameter on-device LLM achieving state-of-the-art performance with open-source agent support.

title: MiniCPM 4.1 Base Model: 8B Native Sparse Deep Thinking
abstract: MiniCPM 4.1 introduces an 8B base model with native sparse deep thinking capabilities.
